text: This document is the front matter copyright notice and user agreement for the S1000D technical publications specification suite. It establishes copyright ownership by the aerospace and defence industry association and member nations, defines special usage rights for various categories of organizations and companies, and sets forth the complete licensing terms, intellectual property restrictions, warranty disclaimers, liability limitations, and dispute resolution procedures governing use of the specification and its associated materials.

This document is an introductory chapter explaining the purpose and historical development of the S1000D specification. It describes S1000D as an international standard for technical publication procurement and production, originally developed by European aerospace and defense industries in the early 1980s and now jointly maintained by international organizations. The chapter details the specification's evolution from military and civil aviation documentation practices, key advantages of standardization, and subsequent international agreements establishing joint governance and harmonization efforts across North American and European organizations.

This document is an introductory chapter explaining the scope and fundamental purpose of the S1000D specification. It describes S1000D as an international standard for planning, managing, and distributing technical documentation across the lifecycle of civil and military products (vehicles and equipment). The chapter details how S1000D uses modular data units, neutral formats compliant with ISO and W3C standards, and centralized databases to enable reusable, platform-independent technical information that reduces costs and ensures consistency across multiple output formats.
